title: 美联储对前 First Security Bancorp 员工采取执法行动
originalTitle: Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with former employee of First Security Bancorp
summary: 美联储对前 First Security Bancorp 员工 Rush F. Harding III 发出同意令兼停止及终止令，因其违反受托责任及违反 Regulation W。
